# Malabar Journeys — Atelier de Voyage · Fort Kochi

> Independent journeys across backwaters, spice hills, and coastal roads of Kerala, India, with certified native chauffeurs or curated self-drive rentals from Fort Kochi.

## Overview
Malabar Journeys is a boutique slow-travel atelier and independent vehicle garage located on Calvathy Road, near the Old Customs Jetty in Fort Kochi, Kerala (682001). We design unhurried itineraries across the Malabar Coast and the Western Ghats, and maintain a dedicated fleet of motorcycles, sedans, SUVs, custom campervans, and executive coaches.

## Curated Slow Itineraries
- **Munnar & The Cardamom Hills** (3 Days · High Range, from ₹14,200): Ascend colonial cart paths into fragrant cloud forests, visiting boutique organic tea factories and shaded spice groves at 1,600m altitude. Includes Private Chauffeur + Estate Stay.
- **Vembanad & Alleppey Houseboat** (2 Nights · Waterway Drift, from ₹18,500): Glide along palm-sheltered lagoons on an exclusive anjili-wood barge, moored at secluded village jetties as twilight falls. Full Board · Private Chef.
- **Wayanad Rainforest & Coffee** (4 Days · Rainforest, from ₹19,800): Dense canopy walks, prehistoric caves, and tranquil stays inside heirloom coffee plantations in the northern Western Ghats.
- **Old Fort Kochi & Mattancherry** (Single Day · Cultural, from ₹3,400): An unhurried historical stroll past Dutch palaces, Syrian spice godowns, and historic cantilevered Chinese fishing nets.
- **Marari Coastline & Village Drift** (2 Days · Coastline, from ₹8,900): Fisherfolk hamlets, quiet secluded beaches, and barefoot walks through coir-weaving co-operatives along the Arabian Sea.

## The Malabar Garage Fleet
- **Royal Enfield Hunter 350 & Activa 125** (Bikes & Scooters · 2 Seats · Self-drive): ₹800 / day. Ideal for Fort Kochi alleyways and coastal back-roads to Chellanam beach.
- **Toyota Etios & Maruti Ciaz** (Sedans · 4 Seats + Luggage · Chauffeur): ₹2,400 / 80km. Air-conditioned city travel and Cochin International Airport pickups.
- **Toyota Innova Crysta & Fortuner** (Luxury SUVs · 6–7 Seats · Ghat Specialist): ₹3,800 / day. Sure-footed across high-range ghats of Munnar, Idukki, and cardamom ridges.
- **Force Custom Campervan** (Caravans · Sleeps 3–4 · Off-grid Living): ₹7,200 / day. Self-contained road trips with kitchenette, fold-out beds, and solar battery bank.
- **Force Urbania & Luxury Coaches** (Buses & Coaches · 12–26 Seats · Group Travel): On Quote / customized. Executive family gatherings and plantation retreats with dual-zone climate control.

## Core Ethos & Service Standards
1. **Native Chauffeurs**: Experienced local drivers who know every river ferry crossing, forest checkpoint, quiet toddy shop, and monsoon detour across the Western Ghats.
2. **Transparent Billing**: Clear per-kilometer and daily rates. Fuel, interstate permits, parking receipts, and driver allowances explained upfront with zero hidden charges.
3. **Direct 24/7 Kochi Desk**: Speak directly to our mechanics and dispatchers in Fort Kochi from 06:00 – 22:00 IST daily (24/7 emergency road support).
